actions: Enumerate subdomains via certificate transparency logs and search index dumps
Identify technology stack, framework footprints, and reverse proxies
Collect archived URLs via Wayback Machine and Common Crawl
Spider application routes, single page application (SPA) client-side routes, and JS chunk manifests
Extract hidden API endpoints from client-side JavaScript bundles and Swagger/OpenAPI specs
Map multi-tenant role hierarchies and identify user-state transitions

SQL_Injection.detection_strategy: Submit single quote, double quote, arithmetic expressions (e.g., 2-1), and sleep functions in each parameter.
subtypes: In-band UNION SQLi: Determine column count with ORDER BY n, match data types, extract DB version/user
Boolean Blind SQLi: Submit TRUE condition (1=1) and FALSE condition (1=2), compare response length and status
Time Blind SQLi: Submit database-specific delays (SLEEP(5), pg_sleep(5), WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5')
Out-of-band (OAST): Submit DNS/HTTP lookup payloads (xp_dirtree, UTL_INADDR)
SQL_Injection.kill_rules: Do not report database 500 error alone without data extraction or boolean differential proof.

Cross_Site_Scripting.detection_strategy: Inject unique alphanumeric canary strings (e.g. z9y8x7) to inspect reflection context (HTML tag, attribute, JS variable).
subtypes: Reflected: Payload in GET/POST echoed immediately in response HTML
Stored: Payload saved to backend database and rendered to subsequent viewers
DOM-based: Source (location.search, hash) passes into dangerous sink (innerHTML, eval) without sanitization
Cross_Site_Scripting.poc_standard: Must pop alert(document.domain) or demonstrate token access; no theoretical payloads without execution context.

Server_Side_Request_Forgery.detection_strategy: Inject collaborator/burpcollaborator/webhook URLs into parameter accepting remote resources.
subtypes: Basic SSRF: Server makes request and returns response body to user
Blind SSRF: Server makes request but does not reflect response (requires OAST DNS/HTTP confirmation)
Cloud Metadata SSRF: Access 169.254.169.254 or internal RFC 1918 addresses
Server_Side_Request_Forgery.kill_rules: Blind DNS ping without access to internal services or metadata is not eligible for bounty unless chained.

Broken_Object_Level_Auth.detection_strategy: Register two separate user accounts (User A, User B). Attempt to read or modify User B's resources using User A's session.
subtypes: Horizontal IDOR: User A accesses User B's private resources at the same privilege tier
Vertical IDOR: User A invokes administrative or higher-tier endpoints without privilege
Broken_Object_Level_Auth.poc_standard: Provide two request-response transcripts showing unauthorized access to second account's data.
